text:
Marta L: Quick vendor question — Scantrix came up in the procurement scan. They're pitching a per-inference + egress billing model. Can we get quick takes on (1) integration effort, (2) how they measure usage, (3) any gotchas for our billing? cc: @Trevor @Samir

Trevor: I poked at their SDK yesterday. Lightweight, python + grpc. Integration is easy but billing is weird: they report tokens and egress bytes only. No compute_ms or GPU-seconds exposed. That makes our cost-reconciliation harder.

Samir: Token billing + egress could double-count costs depending on their unit pricing. We need a sample invoice and a raw usage export (CSV/Parquet) to map to our reconciliation pipeline. Without raw metrics Ops will be messy.

Marta L: Good call. I've asked their rep for a sample invoice. What exact fields do we need on the export to reconcile automatically? I'll send a template.

Jess: Product questions: do they support SSO + SCIM for org provisioning? Also any EU data residency options (we have customers on EU Dedicated)?

Trevor: SDK notes: OIDC SSO supported, no SCIM right now. Network: dedicated hosts require outbound whitelisting of vendor IP ranges. TLS only. Also they propagate trace headers if we send X-Redwood-Trace which is nice.

Procurement Bot: Procurement checklist reminder — required items: pricing-model breakdown, sample-invoice, raw-usage-export, SLA, SSO/SCIM support, termination/Cancellation L4. Log: https://redwood.internal/procurement/checklists/scantrix

Samir: Reconciliation template (minimal): invoice_id, line_item_id, date, customer_external_id, model_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, egress_bytes, unit_price, line_total, invoice_total. Prefer parquet but CSV ok. Also include timestamp granularity (per-request or per-minute).

Marta L: Trevor — can you paste the minimal curl we used so vendor knows we will validate headers and trace-id?

Trevor: Sure, minimal example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.scantrix.ai/v1/infer \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCANTRIX_KEY" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Trace: 12345" \n  -d '{"model":"stability-xl","input":"hello"}'
```

Samir: Also ask them for at least 90 days of historical raw usage in the requested format — finance needs that for the audit and forecast.

Marta L: I'll collate all fields and send the template + reconciliation mapping to the rep today. Target: sample invoice + raw export by EOD Wed. If they can't provide those, we fallback to alternatives. :hourglass_flowing_sand:////

Jess: If they ship SCIM within 30 days i'd be +1 for a small pilot (non-prod).

Marta L: Action items: Marta send template (doing), Trevor confirm SCIM/network timeframe, Samir confirm reconciliation columns, Procurement Bot create JIRA ticket to track vendor deliverables. Thanks everyone!
